overview_description.description: GoCardless is a financial-technology company that provides a global bank-payment platform focused on helping businesses collect and manage payments directly from customers’ bank accounts. It enables companies to set up and process recurring payments as well as one-off payments via direct debit, eliminating manual chasing of invoices and simplifying cash flow management. The platform offers tools for payment collection, real-time tracking, reporting, and notifications, and it supports transactions in 30+ countries through direct debit schemes and open-banking-based payment features. Users can integrate GoCardless with their existing business systems using its API or through pre-built partnerships with accounting and billing software such as Xero, QuickBooks, and Salesforce to automate payment workflows and reconciliation.

about_short_description.short_description: GoCardless provides a bank-payment platform focused on helping businesses collect and manage payments from customers’ bank accounts.

product.name: GoCardless Payments
product.description: A bank-payment platform for collecting and managing domestic and international one-off, recurring, scheduled, and variable payments directly from customers’ bank accounts.

product.name: Recurring Payment Collection
product.description: A service for automatically collecting recurring payments on scheduled due dates, including fixed or variable amounts for subscriptions, invoices, memberships, and instalment plans.

product.name: One-off Payments
product.description: A bank-payment service for collecting individual invoice or other one-time payments directly from a customer’s bank account, with confirmation for eligible instant payment methods.

product.name: International Payments and FX
product.description: A service for collecting customer bank payments across more than 30 countries and settling funds locally or into an existing bank account with integrated foreign-exchange conversion.

product.name: ACH Pull
product.description: A US bank-payment service that automatically pulls one-off or recurring payments from customer bank accounts through ACH Debit, supporting invoice collection, subscriptions, instalments, and bill payments.

product.name: Open Banking Data Services
product.description: Open banking connectivity and bank-account data services that help businesses access customer-authorized account information for payment experiences, financial insights, and risk-related decisions.
